C1500.title: Miner Cartel Coordinating Selfish Mining Attack Detected in Monacoin
C1500.summary: A 2024 study proposes a statistical method based on inter-block time distributions to identify selfish mining in Proof-of-Work chains. Applying it to historical data from Monacoin, Ethereum, and Bitcoin Cash, the researchers found statistical evidence in Monacoin consistent with collaborative selfish mining, in which multiple miners may privately share new blocks and coordinate publication to increase relative rewards.
